keyPoints.en: Short: -er/-est (tall, taller, the tallest). Long: more/most (more beautiful).
keyPoints.bm: Pendek: -er/-est (tall, taller, the tallest). Panjang: more/most (more beautiful).

keyPoints.en: Irregular: good–better–best, bad–worse–worst. Equality: as … as.
keyPoints.bm: Tak sekata: good–better–best, bad–worse–worst. Persamaan: as … as.

keyPoints.en: at + clock time/night; on + day/date; in + month/year/part of day.
keyPoints.bm: at + waktu jam/malam; on + hari/tarikh; in + bulan/tahun/bahagian hari.

keyPoints.en: for + period, since + starting point; place: at (point), on (surface), in (inside), under.
keyPoints.bm: for + tempoh, since + titik mula; tempat: at (titik), on (permukaan), in (di dalam), under.

keyPoints.en: and (add), but (contrast), because (reason), so (result), although (concession), unless (if not).
keyPoints.bm: and (tambah), but (bertentangan), because (sebab), so (akibat), although (walaupun), unless (jika tidak).

keyPoints.en: Never use "although" and "but" in the same sentence.
keyPoints.bm: Jangan gunakan "although" dan "but" dalam ayat yang sama.
